why_nakshiq: We recommend this for its direct proximity to the Lenyadri caves and Bhimashankar temple complex, offering curated heritage stays with local guides included.

We recommend this family-run homestay for its home-cooked meals, local knowledge of meadow trails, and rooms with south-facing windows overlooking pine forests.

signature_experience: Hornbill Nest is the ANIIDCO property at Corbyns Cove (5 km from Port Blair Airport, 100 km from Baratang). Booking aligned with the 6:30 AM Baratang convoy departure (which crosses the Jarawa Reserve from Jirkatang).
